module.purpose: Defines the discriminated status model used to represent whether a tldraw store is unsynchronized, loading, failed, locally synchronized, or remotely synchronized.
module.summary: This module provides a public TypeScript union describing store availability and synchronization state. Each status variant constrains the presence of the store, error, and remote connection fields, allowing consumers to narrow safely by status while distinguishing local synchronization from remote connectivity.
module.businessContext: Supports editor synchronization workflows by exposing reliable store lifecycle and connectivity state. Incorrect status modeling could cause the editor to use unavailable stores or misrepresent synchronization failures.

edgeCases.behavior: Represents a synchronization phase with neither a store nor an error.
Represents failure with an Error and no available store.
Retains the synchronized store and records connectionStatus as offline.

invariants.description: The status field discriminates which store, error, and connection fields are available.
Not-synced, synced-local, and synced-remote states require a TLStore.
The error state requires an Error and excludes a store.
The synced-remote state requires a connection status of online or offline.

assumptions.description: Consumers use status as the discriminant before accessing variant-specific fields.
TLStore is supplied by the imported tldraw schema package.

concurrencyModel.notes: The file contains only compile-time type declarations and performs no runtime operations.
